# Corpus extraction benchmark — Phase 3

**The corpus benchmarked here is synthetic test data**, generated by
`corpus/gen_synthetic.py`. It is not historical material, and these
results say nothing about historical documents or about extraction
quality on real mathematical literature. They measure only the
extractor's throughput, memory use, and recall against planted patterns
in generated data.

Raw output of the run is in `benchmarks/corpus-benchmark.txt`; the
extracted records are in `benchmarks/corpus-synthetic-hits.jsonl`.

## Corpus (synthetic)

- Generator: `corpus/gen_synthetic.py`, fixed seed 20261031, recorded in
  the generator source and in `corpus/synthetic/expected-hits.json`.
- Files: 7 files under `corpus/synthetic/`, one per supported extension
  (.txt, .tex, .wl, .m, .lean, .als, .curry), 150,000 lines each. Every
  file's first line states it is SYNTHETIC TEST DATA.
- Total lines: 1,050,000
- Total bytes: 69,623,312
- Planted hit lines: 21,000 — exactly one planted hit line every 50
  lines (2% hit-line density), the rest neutral filler.
- Expected record counts are computed by the generator from what it
  planted (each planted template is annotated with the families it
  matches, including the moonshine/modular overlaps) and printed by the
  generator; they are not derived from the extractor.

## Run

- Command: `/usr/bin/time -v python3 corpus/extract.py corpus/synthetic benchmarks/corpus-synthetic-hits.jsonl`
- Machine context: 4 CPUs (nproc), Python 3.12.3,
  Linux htch-runtime 7.0.0-39-generic x86_64. The timed job received
  45% of a CPU over the run (shared VM; 9,088 involuntary context
  switches reported by `/usr/bin/time -v`).
- Wall time: 38.97 s (user 17.71 s, system 0.18 s)
- Throughput: 26,943.8 lines/sec (1,050,000 lines / 38.97 s wall)
- Peak RSS: 19,212 kbytes (Maximum resident set size,
  `/usr/bin/time -v`)

## Recall check — expected vs extracted records per family

| Family | Expected (planted) | Extracted | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| moonshine | 6,043 | 6,043 | MATCH |
| monster | 5,010 | 5,010 | MATCH |
| lie | 4,012 | 4,012 | MATCH |
| geometry | 4,895 | 4,895 | MATCH |
| modular | 4,056 | 4,056 | MATCH |
| **total** | **24,016** | **24,016** | **MATCH** |

Recall check result: PASS — extracted counts equal the generator's
planted counts exactly on every family.
